description: This is a Java class implementing a service for managing Two-Factor Authentication configurations within the Fineract platform. It provides methods for retrieving, updating, and formatting configuration data related to 2FA, including email and SMS delivery settings, OTP parameters, and token lifetimes.

classes.name: TwoFactorConfigurationServiceImpl
classes.description: A service class managing Two-Factor Authentication configurations, including retrieval, updates, and formatting templates for notifications.

methods.name: retrieveAll
methods.description: Retrieves all 2FA configuration settings as a Map of name to value.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates 2FA configuration settings based on the provided JsonCommand.

methods.name: isSMSEnabled
methods.description: Checks if SMS delivery is enabled for 2FA.

methods.name: getSMSProviderId
methods.description: Gets the configured SMS provider ID.

methods.name: getSmsText
methods.description: Retrieves the SMS message text template.

methods.name: isEmailEnabled
methods.description: Checks if email delivery is enabled for 2FA.

methods.name: getFormattedEmailSubjectFor
methods.description: Formats the email subject with user and request data.

methods.name: getFormattedEmailBodyFor
methods.description: Formats the email body with user and request data.

methods.name: getFormattedSmsTextFor
methods.description: Formats the SMS text with user and request data.

methods.name: getOTPTokenLength
methods.description: Retrieves the length of OTP tokens.

methods.name: getOTPTokenLiveTime
methods.description: Retrieves the validity duration of OTP tokens in seconds.

methods.name: getAccessTokenLiveTime
methods.description: Retrieves the live time of access tokens in seconds.

methods.name: getAccessTokenExtendedLiveTime
methods.description: Retrieves the extended live time of access tokens in seconds.
